_comment: Monitor settings: the market time zone and the Telegram alert rules, checked on every 1-minute close. Edits are picked up on the next cycle, no restart needed. cooldown_minutes is global; any rule may set its own. The two trendline_break rules send only once per line.
_telegram_enabled_comment: Master switch for monitor alerts and trade position-open/close fill notifications. false pauses notifications without replaying skipped fills. --no-telegram disables notifications for that service process. Offline Mock never sends fill notifications.

supertrend_opposite._comment: At each completed 15m close, notify once when confirmed standard 1h Supertrend (ATR 10 / multiplier 3) and LuxAlgo SuperTrend AI 15m (same defaults as Dashboard: ATR 10, factors 1-5 step 0.5, memory 10, Best cluster) enter opposite directions. No repeating or historical replay. Code changes require monitor restart.

supertrend_near._comment: Signal-code monitor only: complete 1m close within distance_percent of confirmed standard 1h Supertrend (ATR 10 / multiplier 3). Percent = abs(close - ST) / ST * 100; 0.5 means 0.5%. Bearish: close <= ST; bullish: close >= ST; touches included, closes through the line excluded. No candle-to-candle direction requirement. Each direction has its own cooldown_minutes; no stale replay. Settings reload on the next cycle; new code requires monitor restart.

session_open_supertrend._comment: Signal-code monitor only: confirmed 1h ST (ATR 10 / multiplier 3), opening gap versus the previous session's final complete 1m close. monitor_minutes controls the window from the open (positive integer, default 30); cooldown_minutes controls minimum notification spacing (finite nonnegative minutes, default 5). Both reload on the next cycle. Use complete 1m closes beyond the open in the ST direction. Cancel on ST flip; no historical replay. Code changes require monitor restart.

_utc_offset_comment: the market clock (TAIFEX = Taiwan, UTC+8). Every 'now' in the monitor and dashboard is UTC + this, whatever the computer's own timezone, so travelling (e.g. Japan, UTC+9) needs no change. Read at startup: restart monitor.py and dashboard.py after changing it.

support_bottom_third._comment: close inside the support box, in its bottom part (0 = box bottom, 1 = box top)

resistance_top_third._comment: close inside the resistance box, in its top part

box_enter._comment: previous 1-min close outside the newest drawn 15m box, latest close anywhere inside; includes broken/retested boxes; one notification per transition

box_in_out._comment: previous 1-min close inside the box, latest close outside it, either side (support: up = held, down = broke; resistance: up = broke, down = held). Close only, no exit buffer

trendline_near._comment: close within distance_points of a drawn line; set distance_atr (e.g. 0.2) to use hourly ATR instead

trendline_break_below_up._comment: close below a rising line by more than buffer_points; sent once per line

trendline_break_above_down._comment: close above a falling line by more than buffer_points; sent once per line
